q: A Katanga copper mine runs on hydro power and diesel: how does it count each?
title: Katanga copper mines: hydro power and diesel
short: Grid power in the DRC is almost all hydro, so its Scope 2 is low. Diesel for gensets, haul trucks and processing is Scope 1 at about 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. When the grid falls short and gensets run, diesel quickly becomes the largest number.
audience: Copper and cobalt mines and processors in Katanga and Lualaba

ul: Utility bills or meter readings for grid power.
Diesel invoices split by gensets and mobile fleet.
Tonnes of copper and cobalt produced.

p: Power bought across the border from Zambia or elsewhere follows that grid's factor. Keep the contract and invoices.
Cable makers and battery buyers want per tonne figures. Show diesel and power separately so they see what drives the number.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.
